text.p: Tropical Cyclone Gretelle, with 105 mph winds, is approaching the coast of Madagascar from the northeast. Landfall is expected within 12 hours along the southeast coast. High winds, a storm surge, and very heavy rain will likely lead to significant damage.

Tropical Cyclone Pancho-Helinda, with 105 mph winds, is near 14s/89e in the southern Indian Ocean, moving southwest at 3 mph. Slow weakening will continue but this storm will continue to be a significant threat to shipping this period.

Tropical Cyclone Iletta, with 40 mph winds, is near 14s/65e in the southern Indian Ocean, moving west southwest at 7 mph. Slow strengthening is expected making the storm more of a threat to shipping during the next couple days.
There are no further statements at this time.
